text_to_speech: ESKINDER NEGA: Hello, hello. Thank you so much. Eskinder in the studio we also have journalist Martin Schibbye. Martin do you want to say something? Martin Schibbye: It´s wonderful to hear your voice, Eskinder! I have, as many others, been reading your letters from prison and your journalism. It is truly wonderful, wonderful to hear your voice as a free man. And reading your writings from prison, I have understood that in a way you have always been free. Even in prison you have been using your pen, and your words. I am just so delightful, and so happy to see you walk out of that prison. Eskinder Nega: Thank you, thank you, very much. Its wonderful to hear your voice. The support of the international community has been tremendous. And I am thankful. And all I can say is that I am grateful and thank you. Thank you a thousand times. In a text that you wrote, that was published when you left prison, you talked about the challenges ahead. That you are happy to bee free from chains. But that the road ahead was full of forced exile, pain and suffering and even imprisonment. What comes next for you and for Ethiopia? What comes next is the peaceful struggle, we continue to press for democracy. Through peaceful means, and that will not be easy, but we persist. And we shall see what happens in the future…
